mapper.sql: WITH obs AS ( SELECT r.vin, r.occurred_at, (CAST(#{dtcCode} AS text) = ANY (o.dtc_codes)) AS has_dtc FROM diagnostic_result r JOIN ecu_observation o ON o.result_id = r.id WHERE o.ecu_id = #{ecuId} AND r.occurred_at >= #{from} AND r.occurred_at < #{to} ), veh AS ( SELECT vin, MIN(occurred_at) FILTER (WHERE has_dtc) AS first_fault_at, MAX(occurred_at) AS last_diag_at FROM obs GROUP BY vin ), attr AS ( SELECT v.vin, v.first_fault_at, (v.first_fault_at IS NOT NULL) AS faulty, COUNT(p.id) AS matches, MIN(p.lot_no) AS lot_no, MIN(p.serial_no) AS serial_no FROM veh v LEFT JOIN vehicle_part p ON p.vin = v.vin AND p.ecu_id = #{ecuId} AND p.installed_at <= COALESCE(v.first_fault_at, v.last_diag_at) AND (p.removed_at IS NULL OR p.removed_at > COALESCE(v.first_fault_at, v.last_diag_at)) GROUP BY v.vin, v.first_fault_at ), bucketed AS ( SELECT vin, first_fault_at, faulty, CASE WHEN matches = 0 THEN 'NO_HISTORY' WHEN matches > 1 THEN 'AMBIGUOUS' WHEN lot_no IS NULL THEN 'UNKNOWN_LOT' ELSE 'LOT' END AS bucket, CASE WHEN matches = 1 THEN lot_no END AS lot_no, CASE WHEN matches = 1 THEN serial_no END AS serial_no FROM attr )
mapper.select: SELECT bucket, lot_no, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE faulty) AS fault_vehicles, COUNT(*) AS diagnosed_vehicles FROM bucketed GROUP BY bucket, lot_no ORDER BY bucket, lot_no
SELECT vin, serial_no, first_fault_at FROM bucketed WHERE bucket = 'LOT' AND lot_no = #{lotNo} AND faulty ORDER BY first_fault_at, vin LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT p.vin, p.serial_no, p.installed_at, l.occurred_at AS latest_diag_at, l.dtc_codes AS latest_dtc_codes FROM vehicle_part p LEFT JOIN vehicle_ecu_latest l ON l.vin = p.vin AND l.ecu_id = p.ecu_id WHERE ORDER BY p.vin LIMIT #{limit}
